title: Have Mass. farms seen an increase in sales due to cyclospora fears? It’s a mixed bag.
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Massachusetts farms experience mixed sales impacts due to national cyclospora outbreak concerns.
Some farms notice increased lettuce sales and consumer confidence in local produce.
Other farms report no significant change in sales, attributing foot traffic to word of mouth.

title: How should the Red Sox approach the trade deadline?
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: Red Sox, winning 20 of last 23 games, are on the verge of playoff contention.
Craig Breslow may consider trading outfielder Duran or Yoshida to strengthen infield or relief pitching.
Focus should be on improving infield and bullpen without altering the current starting rotation.

title: After homicide ruling, Boston councilor wants officers involved in South Bay jail death placed on leave
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Boston City Councilor Miniard Culpepper urges administrative leave for officers involved in Shacoby Kenny's death at South Bay jail.
State medical examiner ruled Shacoby Kenny's December 2025 death a homicide, sparking calls for independent investigation.
Attorney General's office investigating as other officials demand transparency and reforms in correctional oversight.

title: Norwood Hospital moves closer to being acquired through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Massachusetts Senate approved bill to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain for a nonprofit transfer.
Norwood Hospital closed since 2020 flood; previous operator Steward Health Care filed for bankruptcy in 2024.
Bill allows state to acquire property from current owner MPT; next steps dependent on House approval.

title: Patriots rookie Eli Raridon is looking like a potential Day 1 contributor
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon is emerging as a potential contributor for the Patriots, filling in after Julian Hill's injury.
The rookie tight end impressed in training camp, performing well during team drills and practice sequences.
At 6-foot-6, Raridon's athleticism and size make him a key contender for a backup role on the Patriots.

title: Were they dishonest with me at the quick lube shop?
author: John Paul
bullets: John Paul advises a reader who doubts quick lube shop recommendations for air filter changes due to past replacements.
Mercedes recommends every-three-year brake fluid changes for the C 300 due to moisture absorption, despite low mileage.
For the 2020 Subaru Forester, unresolved rear hatch issues could be due to key fob or switch malfunction or battery problems.

title: Abington police officer placed on leave after chase of stolen car ends in crash that killed 17-year-old boy
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: An Abington officer was placed on leave after a chase led to a crash killing 17-year-old Sebastian Hamilton.
A stolen 2019 Hyundai crashed into a tree on Washington St., injuring four passengers aged 14 to 17.
The police chief emphasized the officer's leave is standard procedure, not punitive, following fatal crashes.

title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez is the top-ranked cornerback in Madden 27 with a 98 overall rating.
Seven other cornerbacks received ratings of 90 or higher, including Patrick Surtain II and Trent McDuffie.
Madden 27 will be released on August 13, with early access available starting August 6.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Boston Red Sox are considering a trade with the Marlins for Otto Lopez and Liam Hicks before the August 3 deadline.
Otto Lopez offers strong defense and hitting skills, batting .329 with the Marlins, appealing as a shortstop option.
Liam Hicks provides power potential with 14 home runs this season, addressing Boston's need for more power in the lineup.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: An 18-year-old woman, Yoseliani Marte, was found dead from a gunshot wound in a Mattapan rental property on July 18.
The rental property where Marte was found is owned by Conan Harris, husband of Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley.
Authorities have ruled Marte's death a homicide, and no arrests have been made as the investigation continues.
